raw:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."legalities" l 
JOIN main."cards" c ON l.uuid = c.uuid 
WHERE l.format = 'standard' AND l.status = 'legal' 
AND c."originalReleaseDate" <= '2021-03-10';
